# SSoQE Copilot instructions

This repository is the canonical source for organization-wide SSoQE agent guidance.

Before substantive work, read `AGENTS.md` and the task-relevant modules it routes to under `.ai/`. Also read `.ai/repository.md` and any closer compatible instructions.

Critical defaults:

- inspect the current repository and Git status before editing;
- treat implementation as authorization for local unstaged edits only; never change branches, stage, commit, push, open or edit a pull request, or merge without explicit authorization for that specific action;
- preserve unrelated changes and never publish private repository information;
- apply standards prospectively rather than cleaning up unrelated material;
- edit source files, not generated Quarto, theme, or publication artifacts;
- use strict reproducible R conventions from `.ai/r-style.md`;
- use the repository's established Quarto render wrapper and validate output;
- use the SSoQE palette, fonts, and current SSoQE logo from `.ai/branding.md` for changed visual material;
- do not add pedagogical or lesson-stage requirements to technical work.
